create_FairChemModel_from_pretrained: create a FairChemModel using a pretrained model name like MACE-MP-0 for energy and force predictions
create_FairChemModel_from_checkpoint: create a FairChemModel from a local checkpoint file path with stress computation enabled
run_FairChemModel_forward: run the FairChemModel forward method on a SimState to get energy, forces, and stress predictions
